int_name: MC CALLUM ST & W MOUNT AIRY AVE

result.summary: The image shows a residential T-intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps. However, the main roadway lacks marked crossings, and sight lines are significantly hindered by overgrown vegetation at the corner.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation at the corner obscures the view between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: The main roadway lacks a marked crosswalk, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the wider street.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt surface on the main road.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove low-hanging branches and dense shrubs at the corner to improve sight triangles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility at the intersection.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a residential street with a sidewalk on one side but lacks effective crossing infrastructure. Faded pavement markings and sightline obstructions from roadside vegetation create potential hazards for pedestrians at this intersection.

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and stop bar markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A tall hedge on the corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers approaching the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Apply new, high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the presence of a crossing.

interventions.title: Daylight the Intersection
interventions.description: Trim vegetation or install curb extensions to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features continuous sidewalks and a low posted speed limit of 25 mph, but lacks marked crosswalks. A significant safety concern is the dense vegetation at the corner, which creates a major visual obstruction for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, overgrown vegetation at the corner blocks the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image at the corner of the two sidewalks

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no visual cue for drivers to expect pedestrians or for pedestrians to know the safest crossing path.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area adjacent to the curb ramp

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracks and uneven surfaces on the sidewalk and curb ramp could pose a trip hazard or difficulty for those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove the dense bushes at the corner to 'daylight' the intersection and restore clear sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Ramp Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and ensure the curb ramp is smooth and fully ADA-compliant.

result.summary: The intersection is located in a residential area with mature trees and lacks comprehensive pedestrian infrastructure. While a partial sidewalk and faded crosswalk marking are present, the environment lacks ADA-compliant ramps and continuous walkways on all sides.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk marking is a single faded line, which provides low visibility to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street on the right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and mature trees at the corner may block the view between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner between the main road and the side street.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk does not appear to continue on the left side of the image, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the main roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk network on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.
